detail.longDescription: Saturday question: what would you throw at a panel of six arguing AIs? Not one model answering you — six with opposing roles, arguing in turns until they have to land on a conclusion, while a human moderates. Last time someone here picked "the meaning of life". The one that brought statistics invented a correlation coefficient Harvard never published, and a WHO ratio that doesn't exist. Both still on the page, struck through. Reply with a topic and I'll run it. # AI # LLM # FOSS # SelfHosted
